_instructions: Reviewable starter learning paths, not assigned training or completion records. Practice time is a suggested exercise length, not a verified course duration. Override this file in <OrgPath>\Content\Learning-Paths.json; keep each id stable. Set Links.PromptLibrary to the customer's approved existing prompt library, or use the existing CoE prompt guide. Owner and reviewedOn blanks mean unassigned and unreviewed, not completed checks. Before launch, assign real learning owners and record actual review dates after checking links, practice tasks, access requirements and local guidance. No EDU CSVs or sensitive records are imported.

items.title: Start safely with one teaching task
items.expectedResult: Preserve dates and requirements; verify wording and follow the course's AI rules.

items.title: Improve a course description
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat with permitted source text
items.expectedResult: Improve clarity without changing learning outcomes, prerequisites, commitments or assessment rules.

items.title: Review and share a reusable teaching pattern
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat; public or synthetic teaching material
items.expectedResult: Check accuracy and accessibility; share instructions and review steps, not student records or assessed student work.

items.title: Start safely with everyday writing
items.expectedResult: Improve a public announcement while preserving dates, requirements and commitments.

items.title: Choose the right source and experience
items.product: Copilot Chat with supplied public or synthetic notes; Microsoft 365 Copilot for work-data search where licensed and enabled
items.expectedResult: Use only supplied or actually accessible sources; mark missing owners and dates instead of inventing them.

items.title: Measure a repeatable improvement
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat with non-sensitive practice material
items.expectedResult: Repeat the writing task. Record actual time including review and correction; compare quality and state limitations.

items.title: Check course rules before using AI
items.practicePromptTitle: Check your syllabus and allowed study uses
items.expectedResult: Explain what the instructor permits, what must be disclosed and where to ask when rules are unclear.

items.title: Understand a concept, not just an answer
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat; public concepts or your own permitted notes
items.expectedResult: Explain the concept in your own words and check it against authoritative course material.

items.title: Check and disclose AI assistance
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat; no third-party personal records
items.expectedResult: Verify facts and citations; do not substitute AI output for assessed work; disclose assistance as required.

items.title: Prepare a safe ten-minute demonstration
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat with public or synthetic demo material
items.expectedResult: Demonstrate the prompt after local approval. Show the source boundary, one follow-up, manual corrections and the applicable data rules.

items.title: Know where questions belong
items.product: Existing institution support and governance routes
items.practicePromptTitle: Route a synthetic access or policy question
items.expectedResult: Distinguish coaching from access approval, policy decisions and incident response.

items.title: Share a useful pattern and honest result
items.product: Approved practice prompt and existing community channels
items.expectedResult: Share non-sensitive instructions, the result, review effort and measured limits with appropriate consent.

items.title: Confirm access and readiness
items.product: Authorized IT review; no platform configuration is changed by this learning list
items.practicePromptTitle: Document readiness checks for a non-production pilot
items.expectedResult: Identify source owners, access boundaries and unresolved prerequisites; do not treat a checklist as completed controls.

items.title: Test the user support journey
items.product: Authorized test accounts and existing support routes
items.practicePromptTitle: Walk through a synthetic missing-access case
items.expectedResult: Separate license, source access, rollout and policy causes; record the support owner without exposing private records.

items.title: Review a proposed internal agent
items.product: Customer-authorized reviewer and appropriate test environment
items.practicePromptTitle: Review agent purpose, sources and permissions
items.expectedResult: Record access/billing prerequisites, positive and negative access tests, support and review dates before publication.

items.title: Choose a permitted agent task
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Agent Builder or Copilot Studio only where enabled and licensed
items.expectedResult: Define purpose, audience and authoritative sources; exclude consequential decisions and unapproved external actions.

items.title: Test evidence and access boundaries
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Approved agent test environment with permitted synthetic or public sources
items.practicePromptTitle: Test an answer, missing evidence and denied access
items.expectedResult: Check traceable answers, uncertainty and permission behavior; document connectors/actions and failures for review.

items.title: Submit the agent for customer review
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Existing institution review process; catalog publication does not share or enable an agent
items.expectedResult: Supply the launch link, owner/backup, sources, allowed data, access, support and test evidence; a reviewer decides publication.
